title: Continuation of junta node learning
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin }n$, let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. For an optional batch of the prescribed restricted sample size, whose examples match $z$ on $P$ when the batch is present, this definition returns the empty decision in a random-example learning program if no batch is supplied. If a batch is supplied, it forms the restricted examples, charges the node-analysis work, and returns the junta-node decision computed from that batch.
